# Handoff — evolution kernel with one unanchored item

Fixture (evolution kernel). K1 carries a recompute command; K2 carries nothing a machine can run
or resolve, so it must be reported. The file name is undated: presence is not required here, but
once the section appears its items are checked regardless of date.

EVOLUTION_KERNEL=
  K1 可复算的承重内容：复算 ls /tmp
  K2 没有任何机械锚的一条

receiver outcome receipt required.
